key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 7.44% significantly breaching the upper tolerance band, driven largely by a sharp 11.51% spike in food inflation, the risks to price stability are elevated. Given the monsoon rainfall deficit of 5.0% and the need to anchor inflation expectations, I believe it is prudent to maintain the current repo rate of 6.50% and continue with the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure inflation aligns with the 4.00% target.
